slides.title: The lowest quote is rarely [the real budget].
slides.lede: A useful budget covers the decisions, assets, approvals and implementation needed to put a new market position into use.

slides.title: Four workstreams, [not one headline fee]
slides.note: The logo is **rarely the largest operational challenge**. Launching it across every document and channel usually is.

slides.title: How a £12,000 fee [becomes a bigger programme]
slides.text: A planning firm spends £12,000 on strategy and identity, then £15,000 to £30,000 on a website and content. Add templates and rollout, and the usable cost nears £35,000.

slides.title: Scope [review rounds] before you sign
slides.text: Avoid vague wording such as compliance support included. Ask who approves, how feedback is consolidated, how many rounds are funded, and what late changes cost.

slides.title: Make the budget reflect the actual business change.
